label: Horizontal Layout
description: Horizontal resizable layout. Best for a header pane stacked over a content pane, split 25 to 75, with a plain line dragged up and down.

label: Vertical Layout
description: Vertical resizable layout.. Best for a sidebar beside a content pane, split 25 to 75, with a plain 1px divider dragged left and right.

label: Mixed Directions
description: Nested mixed-direction resizable layout.. Best for a side pane beside a column that splits again into top and bottom, 3 panes in 2 directions on plain line dividers.

label: Nested Grips
description: Nested resizable. Best for equal halves where the right half splits 25 to 75 top and bottom, on grip dividers with sizes written as percent strings.

label: Animated Pill
description: Handle with animated pill indicator. Best for a short pill on a 30 to 70 split that lengthens on hover, then grows longer and turns primary while pressed.

label: Spring Pill
description: Handle pill with spring scale on drag. Best for a pill drawn at 75 percent scale that eases to full scale on hover, then stretches and turns primary while pressed.

label: Capsule Expansion
description: Handle with large capsule expansion on drag. Best for the longest press state: a pill that widens on hover and reaches 5rem while pressed, as the whole divider line tints primary.

label: Nested Pills
description: Nested layout with animated pill handles. Best for nav beside a toolbar over an editor, with an upright pill on the outer divider and a wide pill on the inner one.

label: Three Panels
description: Three-panel layout with animated pill handles. Best for files, editor and preview in one row split 25, 50 and 25, with 2 pill handles and a minimum size on every pane.

label: Size Tracking
description: State-tracked resizable layout.. Best for live percentage readouts in each pane, fed from the group layout callback into React state as the divider moves.
